data.description:
## Severity: P2

## Problem
On PR #197 cycle 2, the LLM reviewer (standard tier, runs in ci-llm-review-runner.sh) emitted 2 important 'correctness' findings claiming `run-hook-tests.sh`, `run-script-tests.sh`, and `validate-required-checks.sh` did not exist in the repository. All three scripts DO exist (verified via `ls -la`, all executable, owned by sprint commits).

## Reviewer prompt expectation
plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-standard.md states (verification sub-criteria, line ~623):
> If a skill or workflow references a script, agent file, or config key by name, verify the referenced artifact exists via Glob/Read — documentation that references non-existent artifacts is as broken as code that imports a missing module

The Context-Request Protocol (lines ~119-146) provides the `read_files` action precisely for this case. Standard tier is non-light, so the mechanism is available.

## Observed behavior
Reviewer did not emit a `read_files` request before filing the findings. Cycle 2 log shows:
```
WARNING: finding missing relation field — treating as NEW_INTRODUCED (desc: Workflow invokes non-existent test scripts: run-hook-tests.s)
WARNING: finding missing relation field — treating as NEW_INTRODUCED (desc: Workflow invokes non-existent validation script: validate-re)
INFO: cycle 2 — novelty gate downgraded 2 finding(s) (unjustified NEW_INTRODUCED outside prior defense window)
```
Schema correction then bumped suggestion→important.

## Suggested fix paths
1. Strengthen reviewer prompt: make context-aug REQUIRED before flagging any reference-not-found finding. Add explicit instruction near the verification sub-criteria.
2. Detect at dispatch time: if a finding claims 'file X does not exist' and the reviewer never requested X, the dispatcher should auto-downgrade or auto-defend.
3. Add a post-hoc 'finding hallucination check' that verifies any 'file does not exist' claim before letting the finding through.

## Related
- Parent: bug da45-7d92-6c86-42bc (workflow gating)
- PR: #197 cycle 2 (run 26004245894)
- Reviewer prompt: plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-standard.md:622-625
- Context-aug contract: plugins/dso/docs/contracts/ci-review-context-request.md
data.title: CI LLM reviewer fails to use context-augmentation when flagging missing-reference findings
